verified_contracts: Installer default performs only an offline, content-addressed, SHA-verified code installation; no Torch, NumPy, socket or subprocess import is needed for that path.
Prepare and submit-without-explicit-flag do not query Slurm, submit jobs, allocate GPU, start numerical workers, install dependencies or read upload credentials.
Controller requires exact plan SHA authorization before scheduler observation or submission; scheduler commands own only the exact R10 marker and never issue scancel.
Four single-GPU worker slots use16CPUs and68G each; task flock leases plus independent scientific locks protect numerical ownership rather than trusting PIDs.
USR1/STOP checkpoint pause uses exit75; completed exact results are sealed and reused; persistent task failures and preclaim allocation failures have finite quarantine.
Paper channel copies complete CSV/JSON bytes and records exact fragment manifests; no participant rows are truncated or sanitized.
Full channel packs declared task output trees including predictions, per-fit model states and manifests, splits bounded parts and checks hashes; its network retry cannot change training state.
Stage and recipe specific paper/full/monitor paths isolate late mechanism uploads; head-bound non-force CAS retries merge concurrent evidence.
Independent CAS409 test proves an old mechanism publication reloads a concurrently published formal index and preserves the formal active pointer and both channel records.
CPU validation and existing-allocation GPU precheck are separate finite commands; this review executed CPU and mocked checks only.
Formal confirmation load_plan runs a standard-library-only metadata/history/session and NPY-header audit before submission, with sample hashing deferred to first scientific open.

Positive independent-confirmation metadata fixture uses40unique acquired events and cache rows, an actual safe40x11x128 NPY, physical prefix/future runs, and an exact dataset/participant history review; the real metadata guard runs without a mock.
Optional incomplete R9 EA/RAW feature-reference reuse does not become a new GPU startup gate; the frozen strategy selects meta_train-prefix reference construction across all3seeds.
The final delivery selector packages authored research and bounded compact evidence while excluding recursive historical result trees and arrays.
